layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Optical Alignment over Geometrical. Lots of negative space.
layout_and_spacing.masonry_grid: columns-1 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3 xl:columns-4 gap-6 space-y-6
layout_and_spacing.card_padding: p-0 for image, p-4 or p-5 for content inside card

header.style: Sticky top, Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/40 in light mode, dark mode equivalent), z-50
header.elements: Logo, Large Search Bar (rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800), Navigation (Explore, Categories), User Avatar

hero.style: Massive text, highly emotional, lots of breathing room, centered layout. Background can use subtle mesh gradient or abstract 3D elements.
hero.title: text-5xl md:text-6xl+ tracking-tighter font-semibold

product_card.style: Rounded-2xl overflow-hidden cursor-pointer, soft shadow-sm, minimal border. Break-inside-avoid for masonry.
product_card.hover_state: Image scales up slightly (group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500). Glassmorphic overlay appears with Like/Save buttons. Author details visible at bottom.

sidebar_filters.style: Sticky on desktop, clean checklist or pill-shaped toggles. Rounded-full chips for active categories.

buttons.style: Rounded-full for main CTAs (adds friendly community vibe), smooth hover translations (-translate-y-0.5), subtle shadow.

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract 3D glass shape, use for hero background or large aesthetic accents

testing.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

tech_stack.icons: lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react for design tool vibes

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for complex marketing grids, and Shadcn UI components for functional areas (forms, dialogs, selects).
Use CSS columns (columns-2 md:columns-3 lg:columns-4 gap-6) for the masonry grid, avoiding complex JS libraries unless necessary. Add 'break-inside-avoid' to children items.
Hover states on product cards MUST be expressive: overlay a dark transparent gradient, slide up the 'Save' and 'Like' buttons.
CRITICAL: The UI is in RUSSIAN. Make sure all static text is translated to Russian (e.g., 'Поиск', 'Категории', 'Избранное', 'В тренде').
Ensure dark mode is perfectly toggled using Tailwind 'dark:' variants.
Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl extensively on images and cards to mimic Dribbble/Behance smooth aesthetics.
Implement glassmorphism according to guidelines: bright and saturated with subtle white/gray borders to maintain boundaries.
Provide functionality to switch themes, upload designs, moderate templates, and view personal accounts per problem statement.
